name: Merel
description: Daghatar's uncle, who refused the khanship in his youth, a council elder who sees the dragons' strength with grim realism.

timeline.summary: Daghatar convenes twenty Abzan advisors at Mer-Ek, and Reyhan and Merel argue between striking at Dromoka and enduring.
timeline.quote: We bring down Dromoka, and her brood will scatter.

timeline.summary: Merel warns that the first battle against Dromoka cost over a thousand soldiers with no damage to her, and Daghatar acknowledges the Abzan may be facing the end.
timeline.quote: we may be facing the end of the Abzan.

timeline.summary: Daghatar travels to the site of the first battle with Dromoka to meet her emissaries.
timeline.quote: On behalf of the Eternal, we welcome you. I am Sohemus.

timeline.summary: Daghatar orders every kin-tree uprooted and necromancy forbidden, and Dromoka nods; Merel warns of civil war.
timeline.quote: Uproot every kin-tree. The practice of necromancy is hereby forbidden.

relations.quote: This was Merel, Daghatar's uncle—a man who refused the khanship himself in his younger days.

pages_say.description: Daghatar's uncle, who refused the khanship in his youth, a council elder who sees the dragons' strength with grim realism.
